title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Judicial Application of Blockchain
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinion on Strengthening the Application of Blockchain in the Judicial Field

Fa Fa [2022] No. 16

In order to thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and the important directive of General Secretary Xi Jinping on actively promoting blockchain technology to provide the people with more intelligent, more convenient, and higher-quality public services, to implement the "14th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Outline of Long-Range Objectives for 2035" and the "14th Five-Year National Informatization Plan", to give full play to the role of blockchain in promoting judicial credibility, serving social governance, preventing and resolving risks, and promoting high-quality development, to comprehensively deepen the construction of smart courts, to advance the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity, and in light of the actual work of the people's courts, this Opinion is formulated.

I. Overall Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, deeply implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and General Secretary Xi Jinping's important thoughts on building a strong cyber country, closely focus on the goal of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case", adhere to serving the overall situation, judicial for the people, and impartial justice, vigorously promote the deep integration of blockchain technology with diversified dispute resolution, litigation services, trial enforcement, and judicial management, actively apply blockchain platforms to serve social governance, optimize the business environment, strengthen the construction of the credit system, prevent and resolve major risks, support the construction of a new development pattern, and strive to create a higher level of digital justice.

(2) Overall Goal. By 2025, establish a blockchain alliance that is interconnected and shared between the people's courts and all sectors of society, form a relatively complete application standard system for blockchain in the judicial field, significantly improve basic support capabilities such as data verification, trusted operations, smart contracts, and cross-chain coordination; blockchain will be fully applied in diversified dispute resolution, litigation services, trial enforcement, and judicial management, effectively promoting judicial credibility, improving judicial efficiency, and strengthening clean justice; the judicial blockchain cross-chain alliance will be integrated into the economic and social operation system, realizing cross-chain information sharing and coordination with multiple fields such as political and legal affairs, industry and commerce, finance, environmental protection, and credit reporting, actively serving the optimization of the business environment, economic and social governance, risk prevention and resolution, and industrial innovation and development, assisting in the construction of a Safe China, a Rule-of-Law China, a Digital China, and a Creditworthy China, forming a world-leading application model of blockchain in the judicial field with Chinese characteristics, and providing strong judicial services and guarantees for the digital transformation and high-quality development of China's economy and society in the new era.

(3) Basic Principles

Adhere to overall planning according to law and focus on coordinated linkage. Strengthen the overall planning of blockchain infrastructure in accordance with laws and regulations, carry out top-level design for the application of blockchain in the judicial field based on the needs of economic and social development and trial enforcement work, strengthen research on cross-chain collaborative application models with various industries, and promote multi-party data sharing and collaborative application.

Adhere to openness and sharing and focus on standards first. Build a blockchain alliance that is interconnected and shared with all sectors of society, form common basic technical support capabilities, establish a unified and open technical standard system for blockchain application in the judicial field, and provide standardized services for cross-department node access and cross-industry data co-maintenance and utilization.

Adhere to application-driven and focus on innovative development. Guided by judicial for the people, impartial justice, and serving social governance, give full play to the role of blockchain in optimizing business processes, improving coordination efficiency, and building a trusted system, continuously promote the deep application of blockchain in the judicial field, and continuously improve cross-domain automatic execution capabilities.

Adhere to safety and reliability and focus on orderly advancement. On the premise of safety and trustworthiness, focus on improving the accuracy and controllability of on-chain data and smart contracts, ensure data security, protect personal information, and promote the formation of a safe, reliable, steady, and orderly application ecosystem for blockchain in the judicial field.

II. Requirements for Building the People's Court Blockchain Platform

(4) Strengthen the top-level design of blockchain application. In accordance with legal norms and the overall idea of efficient internal and external coordination, systematically carry out scenario design for blockchain application in the judicial field based on the needs of court business applications and service social governance collaborative applications. For the needs of internal and external network collaborative applications, form a national unified overall blockchain construction plan that supports cross-network, cross-chain collaborative judicial applications.

(5) Continue to promote cross-chain collaborative application capability building. For the scenarios of actively serving economic and social governance and judicial business applications, build a blockchain alliance infrastructure based on distributed identifiers, interconnection, and cross-chain mutual trust, effectively integrate the existing construction results of the enforcement blockchain, give full play to the technical characteristics of the alliance chain, strengthen the construction of cross-chain alliances between the judicial blockchain platform and blockchain platforms in various industries, and continuously improve coordination capabilities.

(6) Enhance judicial blockchain technical capabilities. Combine advantageous forces, carry out key technology breakthroughs, build an open and shared national court judicial blockchain platform, improve basic technical capabilities such as data verification, trusted operations, smart contracts, and cross-chain coordination, and support people's courts at all levels to carry out business innovation applications based on the judicial blockchain platform.

(7) Build an internet judicial blockchain verification platform. Based on the data of the national judicial blockchain platform, build a judicial blockchain verification platform on the internet side, supporting parties and other relevant entities to verify the authenticity of judicial data such as mediation data, electronic evidence, and litigation documents.

(8) Establish and improve the standard specification system. Establish and improve technical standards and management specifications for the application of blockchain in the judicial field, providing technical guidance and standard interface support for interconnection, sharing, and coordination with blockchain platforms and nodes in related fields.

III. Fully Utilize Blockchain Data Tamper-Proof Technology to Further Enhance Judicial Credibility

(9) Ensure judicial data security. Promote the on-chain storage of judicial data such as electronic volumes, electronic archives, judicial statistical reports, and case closure status of the people's courts, ensure that judicial data is tamper-proof, and enhance the level of data security.

(10) Ensure trustworthiness of electronic evidence. Improve and perfect the evidence verification function of the blockchain platform, support parties and judges to verify electronic evidence stored on the blockchain online, promote the improvement of standards and rules for blockchain evidence preservation, and improve the efficiency and quality of electronic evidence identification.

(11) Ensure compliance of enforcement operations. Promote the on-chain storage and certification of data and operations such as enforcement case information, party information, organization information, enforcement notices, property investigation and control, property disposal, case fund receipt and distribution, credit sanctions, law enforcement evidence collection, enforcement interaction, case closing, and file archiving, regularly conduct security audits of the entire enforcement business process operations, further standardize enforcement operation behavior, explore online closed-loop verification of sensitive operations such as enforcement investigation and control, and ensure reliability and error-free.

(12) Ensure the authority of judicial documents. Promote the unified storage of litigation documents served by the people's courts and service receipts on the judicial blockchain platform, support the online verification of served documents, ensure the safety and reliability of the entire service process, and maintain judicial authority.

IV. Give Full Play to the Important Role of Blockchain in Optimizing Business Processes to Continuously Improve Judicial Efficiency

(13) Support the application of case filing information flow. Establish business rules for the automatic flow of case filing registration materials by level and category, support automatic case filing by level and category after the material submission deadline expires, consolidate the reform results of the case filing registration system, and improve case filing efficiency.

(14) Support the connection application of mediation and trial processes. Establish business rules and smart contract procedures for the automatic triggering of trial case filing and enforcement case filing upon non-performance of mediation agreements, enhance the judicial authority of mediation procedures, and support diversified dispute resolution.

(15) Support the connection and linkage of trial and enforcement processes. Comprehensively promote information sharing and data exchange between trial and enforcement case handling systems, explore the establishment of business rules and linkage mechanisms for the automatic triggering of enforcement case filing upon non-performance of judgment documents, optimize the connection between trial and enforcement, smooth information flow, reduce duplication of work, and support the effective resolution of enforcement difficulties.

(16) Support improving enforcement efficiency. Explore the establishment of smart contract mechanisms for the automatic initiation of inquiries, freezes, and deductions in eligible enforcement cases, as well as the automatic distribution of enforcement funds; establish a smart contract mechanism for the automatic resumption of enforcement (without the need for a separate case filing process) for cases where the property line is fully investigated but the case is closed as "enforcement cannot be completed" (终本) and for enforcement settlement cases where the obligor fails to perform.

(17) Support convenient case handling for enforcement officers. Use blockchain technology to promote the extension of network investigation and control, evaluation and auction, case fund receipt and distribution, credit restriction and consumption restriction, matter entrustment, and electronic volume generation with the case to mobile terminals, forming decentralized, network-independent, system-independent data concatenation, making it convenient for enforcement officers to handle enforcement affairs anytime and anywhere.

V. Fully Tap the Great Potential of Blockchain Interconnection and Linkage to Enhance Judicial Coordination Capabilities

(18) Improve the coordination capability of lawyer qualification verification. For the demand of lawyer qualification verification, build a cross-chain collaborative application between the people's courts and judicial administrative departments, support the online query and verification of lawyer qualifications and credit reports for lawyers participating in litigation activities, and improve the real-time nature of verification.

(19) Improve the coordination capability of cross-department case handling in political and legal affairs. For the needs of cross-department collaborative handling of cases such as commutation and parole, criminal, civil and commercial matters, and citizen identity authentication, build cross-chain collaborative applications between the people's courts and procuratorial, public security, and judicial administrative departments, improving the efficiency of online case flow and the level of mutual data trust.

(20) Improve cross-department collaborative enforcement capabilities. For the needs of property investigation and control of judgment debtors and joint sanctions against dishonest judgment debtors, build cross-chain collaborative applications between the people's courts and units such as administrative law enforcement, real estate registration, financial securities and insurance institutions, and joint credit sanctions, establish automated enforcement investigation and control and credit sanction models, and improve the efficiency of collaborative enforcement work.

VI. Fully Utilize the Value Attribute of Blockchain Alliance Mutual Trust to Serve Economic and Social Governance

(21) Protect intellectual property. Build a cross-chain coordination mechanism with intellectual property blockchain platforms such as copyright, trademark, and patent, support the query and verification of information on intellectual property ownership, registration, and transfer, provide convenience for evidence identification in intellectual property cases, and better serve the implementation of the national innovation-driven strategy.

(22) Support business environment optimization. Build cross-chain collaborative application mechanisms with blockchain platforms such as market supervision, property rights registration and trading platforms, support the query and verification of information on basic enterprise information, changes in corporate equity, inter-enterprise relationships, ownership status of real estate and movable property, financial leasing, and precious metal transactions, provide convenience for ownership identification and property rights transactions, promote the construction of a classified and graded regulatory system based on data and credit, and better serve the national business environment construction.

(23) Support data development and utilization. Build cross-chain collaborative application mechanisms with blockchain platforms such as data ownership and data trading, support the query, verification, and smart contract disposal of process information such as data confirmation and data trading, help build the data factor market and release data value, and better serve the implementation of the national big data strategy.

(24) Support financial information flow application. Build cross-chain collaborative application mechanisms with blockchain platforms of financial institutions, support the query, verification, and smart contract disposal of process information such as approval, performance, and breach of financial loan contracts and credit cards, and better serve financial risk prevention and resolution.

(25) Support enterprise bankruptcy and reorganization. Build cross-chain collaborative application mechanisms with blockchain platforms of relevant government departments, support the information sharing of debtor enterprises' business information and litigation/enforcement information, support online verification and cross-examination of creditor claims information, while protecting the right to know and inspect of all creditors, strengthen the openness and transparency of creditor review, and further ensure the voting effectiveness of online creditors' meetings, better serving the rescue and exit of market entities.

(26) Support credit reporting system construction. Build cross-chain collaborative application mechanisms with the national credit information sharing platform, the national enterprise credit information publicity system, and dishonesty punishment departments, support the query, verification, and smart contract disposal of information on dishonest judgment debtors and restricted consumption, ensure the credible generation, secure dissemination, and compliant use of dishonesty information, better play the role of joint dishonesty sanctions, help improve the new credit-based regulatory mechanism, and serve the construction of the social credit system.

VII. Safeguard Measures

(27) Strengthen organizational leadership. People's courts at all levels shall attach great importance to the construction and application of blockchain in the judicial field, strengthen overall coordination, and designate a leading department for the task to be responsible for the overall promotion and management of blockchain application.

(28) Establish a coordination mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall coordinate the focus of blockchain application in their jurisdictions, join forces with other political and legal units, social institutions, etc., to strengthen the collaborative work mechanism, and jointly promote the application of blockchain in the judicial field.

(29) Increase support. People's courts at all levels shall incorporate blockchain application work into the overall planning of smart court construction for organization and implementation, combine it with local government social governance innovation, strive for financial support, and increase propulsion efforts.

(30) Focus on application demonstration. People's courts at all levels, facing the needs of serving economic and social development and the business needs of the people's courts, shall select relatively mature application scenarios to carry out typical application demonstrations, forming replicable and scalable innovative models.

(31) Ensure safety and reliability. People's courts at all levels shall improve the pre-review and testing evaluation mechanisms to ensure the authenticity, accuracy, and compliance of on-chain data and the consistency of on-chain and off-chain data, and ensure the legality, validity, safety, and reliability of smart contracts.

(32) Actively promote and guide. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen the promotion of successful cases, carry out blockchain technology application training for court police officers, and comprehensively enhance the effectiveness of blockchain application in the judicial field.

May 23, 2022
